observed_flows: Account and Customize overview with app counts
Plugins app directory with separate plus buttons and lock state
GitHub app detail, Apps list and Information metadata
Google Drive app detail and Google Docs / Google Drive Comments / Google Sheets / Google Slides skill chips
Google Sheets skill instructions and workflow guidance
ElevenLabs app description and visible agents skills
Tripsy app detail and travel task cards
Install plugin action at the bottom of app details
Files app-style picker with Upload files and Recent items
Create image, Search, Thinking, Deep research and Study tool choices

implemented_flows.connector_details: App details now show app icon/monogram, publisher when legible, description, app targets, skill list, capabilities, developer, website, version, privacy policy, terms, authentication and permissions. Unseen fields remain not supplied / not verified.
implemented_flows.skills: Skill cards open a dedicated skill detail screen with a local Use skill switch, source/status notes and Use in chat action. The exact skill names visible in the source are preserved; illustrative task examples are labelled as such.
implemented_flows.install: Install plugin and directory plus actions open an app-specific consent sheet with disclosures about memory, chat context, suggested prompts and model improvement. Continue only adds the record to the local demo; it never marks the provider connected.
implemented_flows.composer: Plus opens Camera, Photos, Files, Plugins and Think harder. Camera and Photos use browser/device picker inputs; Files opens an in-app recent file browser and device upload picker.
implemented_flows.tool_modes: Plugins opens Create image, Search, Thinking, Deep research, Study and OpenAI Platform. Think harder, Search, Thinking, Deep research and Study toggle local composer modes and can be cleared.
implemented_flows.drawer: Images, Search, Codex, Explore and Upgrade to Pro are added to the existing drawer while retaining previous navigation entries.

honesty_and_scope: Camera/Photos depend on browser and operating-system picker support.
Files stores metadata only; it does not upload file bytes to an AI provider.
Connector OAuth, provider API calls and real account permissions are not connected.
Search and Deep research do not perform live retrieval in this offline build.
Thinking and Think harder are interface controls only; hidden reasoning is not exposed.
Skill names and excerpts that are blurred or not legible in the source video are not invented or represented as official verified metadata.
